title: Towel Bar 18-Inch Solid Brass Wall-Mounted | Lavender | Carolina | Allied Brass | Towel Bar Holder Rail Bath | Allied Brass
description:
Stop draping towels over doors and faucets—install a wall-mounted towel bar that keeps daily towels dry, visible, and easy to reach in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. This Carolina Collection piece is a bath towel bar that also works as a towel rack or towel holder, bringing traditional bathroom hardware style to classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Use your space better: wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging design keeps counters and floors clear
- Coordinate the room: part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina accessories across the bathroom
- Durable materials: solid brass with brass construction

- Length: 18 Inch
- Overall width: 20

- Weight: 2.4 lbs

multiple designer finish options available
